= Truffle interop

This module provides interop facilities with other truffle languages.

[code,lisp]
----
(requires "builtin/truffle.lisp")
----



== +<truffle-native-library>+

[.islisp-kind]_class_

.Superclasses
* <object>



Class for interop truffle objects representing a library loaded through FFI facilities.

== +<truffle-object>+

[.islisp-kind]_class_

.Superclasses
* <object>



Class for interop truffle objects with fields.

== +<truffle-vector>+

[.islisp-kind]_class_

.Superclasses
* <basic-vector>



Class for interop truffle object which are vector-like.

== +load-native-library+

[.islisp-kind]_function_

[subs="+quotes"]
----
(load-native-library name) => <truffle-native-library>
----



Loads a native library with given _name_.
An error shall be signaled if  _name_ is not a string (error-id. _domain-error_).
Interop errors are signalled as an instance of *<truffle-interop-error>*.

== +native-library-symbol+

[.islisp-kind]_function_

[subs="+quotes"]
----
(native-library-symbol native-library symbol signature => <object>
----



Retrieves binding _symbol_ in given _native_library_. _signature_ specifies the shape of the binding such that it can be transposed into truffle runtime. See truffle's NFI documentation for details.
An error shall be signaled if  _native-library_ is not an instance of *<truffle-native-library>* or if either _signature_ or _symbol_ is not a string (error-id. _domain-error_).
Interop errors are signalled as an instance of *<truffle-interop-error>*.

== +set-truffle-object-field+

[.islisp-kind]_function_

[subs="+quotes"]
----
(set-truffle-object-field value truffle-obj field-name) => <object>
----



Sets value of _field-name_ field in _truffle-obj_ to _value_. Returns _value_.
An error shall be signaled if  _truffle-obj_ is not an instance of *<truffle-object>*, or if _field-name_ is not a string (error-id. _domain-error_).
Interop errors are signalled as an instance of *<truffle-interop-error>*.

== +truffle-interop-error-message+

[.islisp-kind]_function_

[subs="+quotes"]
----
(truffle-interop-error-message error => <string>
----



Retrieves message attached to _error_ raised during truffle interop operations.
An error shall be signaled if  _error_ is not an instance of *<truffle-interop-error>*.

== +truffle-object-field+

[.islisp-kind]_function_

[subs="+quotes"]
----
(truffle-object-field truffle-obj field-name) => <object>
----



Returns a value of a field named by _field-name_ in given _truffle-obj_.
An error shall be signaled if  _truffle-obj_ is not an instance of *<truffle-object>*, or if _field-name_ is not a string (error-id. _domain-error_).
Interop errors are signalled as an instance of *<truffle-interop-error>*.

== +truffle-object-field+

[.islisp-kind]_setf_

[subs="+quotes"]
----
(setf (truffle-object-field truffle-obj field-name) value) => <object>
----



Sets value of _field-name_ field in _truffle-obj_ to _value_. Returns _value_.
An error shall be signaled if  _truffle-obj_ is not an instance of *<truffle-object>*, or if _field-name_ is not a string (error-id. _domain-error_).
Interop errors are signalled as an instance of *<truffle-interop-error>*.

== +truffle-object-fields+

[.islisp-kind]_function_

[subs="+quotes"]
----
(truffle-object-fields truffle-obj) => <vector>
----



Returns a vector of strings, listing fields exposed by given truffle obj.
An error shall be signaled if  _truffle-obj_ is not an instance of *<truffle-object>* (error-id. _domain-error_).
Interop errors are signalled as an instance of *<truffle-interop-error>*.
